subject: Dedicated capacity ramp: proposed staircase schedule & term DISCUSSION
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@stratusai.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ramp plan idea for Dedicated capacity (multi-year prepay)

Hi Tessa / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the perf numbers look great. We need to lock a predictable cost profile for inference as we hit production this fall. High level ask: a 3-year agreement with an annual prepay option and a phased delivery of GPUs/TPM over 12 months.

Rough forecast (Q3–Q4 runway + 2027):
- Year 1 (2026): start with 40 GPUs equivalent (NVIDIA A100 80GB tpm estimate) ramp to 120 by end of Q4
- Year 2 (2027): steady 160 GPUs equivalent
- Year 3 (2028): 240 GPUs equivalent (end state)

Constraints: we can’t commit all spend upfront — prefer annual prepay with the option to frontload Year 1 by 50% if the economics are right. Target: 20–30% term discount on list for a 3yr commitment, with milestone-based delivery credits if Redwood misses onboarding SLAs.

Can you share a staircase-style proposal (milestones, amortized credits, and suggested discount tiers) and confirm how capacity will be provisioned incrementally (allocation windows, lead times, and any milestone acceptance tests)? Also — any constraints on mixing quantized/standard instances across the ramp?

I attached a forecast workbook with our monthly expected TPM and token volumes (StratusAI-forecast.xlsx).

Best,
Alex
VP Platforms, StratusAI

Attachment: StratusAI-forecast.xlsx (Excel workbook, 120KB)

From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@stratusai.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ramp plan idea for Dedicated capacity (multi-year prepay)

Alex — thanks for the clear forecast and the workbook. This is exactly the kind of visibility we need to build a practical staircase. A few quick confirmations up front:

- We can support an annual prepay structure (yearly invoices with upfront payment) and also offer a blended option where Year 1 is split 50/50 (50% now, 50% at 6 months) to help your cash flow.
- Term discounts: typical range for 3yr reserved capacity is 15–30% depending on committed aggregate spend and elasticity clauses. We can tier discounts by committed average GPUs/TPM across the term.
- Staging: Redwood will deliver capacity in three milestone windows in Year 1 (baseline -> mid-ramp -> full ramp). Each window will include an acceptance check (basic throughput and latency tests) and associated delivery credits if missed.

I'll ask Karthik to run the discount ladder and sketch a draft staircase schedule (tranche sizes, milestone dates, credit mechanics). Laura will include operational onboarding SLAs and acceptance criteria in the doc. Expect a formal PDF proposal and pricing grid tomorrow.

Two quick clarifying Qs for you:
1) When you say "120 by end of Q4 (Year 1)" — is that 120 total GPUs or 120 GPU equivalents in peak?
2) Any firm constraint on prepay timing? If you need the 50% frontload by July 1, that affects our provisioning windows.

Thanks — speak soon.

— Tessa Morgan
Senior Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192

From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Ramp plan idea for Dedicated capacity (multi-year prepay)

Internal — looping you both to nail the numbers. Quick modeling notes and constraints I want reflected in the proposal:

- Pricing basis: we price by "GPU-equivalent" node (our canonical unit) and map to TPM when customers want an expectation. For Stratus we should show both: GPU-equivalent counts and an estimated monthly TPM baseline (use Alex's workbook).
- Proposed Year 1 staircase (working draft):
  * Milestone A (onboarding window, target start Aug 1): 40 GPUs-equivalent baseline provisioned.
  * Milestone B (mid-ramp, target Oct 1): additional 40 GPUs-equivalent (cumulative 80).
  * Milestone C (end Q4, target Dec 15): additional 40 GPUs-equivalent (cumulative 120).
- Prepay structure options to present (three options):
  1) Full annual prepay per year (highest discount).
  2) 50/50 year-1 split (50% upfront, 50% at 6 months) — moderate discount, helps Stratus cashflow.
  3) Monthly invoicing against an annual committed cap (lowest discount).
- Discount ladder idea: base 15% for 3yr minimum, +5% for annual prepay, +5% for commit >=150 GPU-equivalents average, +5% performance SLAs/extended term add-on (cap 30%). Need Karthik to compute blended effective price and show unit $/GPU-mo under each option.
- Credits: suggest milestone credit of 5% of that milestone's annualized value if provisioning delays exceed 10 business days (subject to force majeure carveouts).

Action items: Karthik — can you run a tab showing per-option $/GPU-mo and the effective incremental credit exposure? Laura — draft the onboarding acceptance checklist and standard SLA language for the proposal PDF. I'll assemble the cover letter and the staircase diagram.

-Tessa

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@stratusai.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ramp plan idea for Dedicated capacity (multi-year prepay)

Alex — thanks for the patience. Attached is RDW-Dedicated-Onramp-Proposal-v3.pdf which contains the staircase schedule, pricing grid, and milestone credits. Key points in the pricing attachment (brief):

- Year 1 staircase windows: Aug 1 (40), Oct 1 (+40 -> 80), Dec 15 (+40 -> 120). We call out lead times and a 14-day provisioning SLA for each tranche.
- Pricing table (example units):
  * List price: $5,400 / GPU-eq / month
  * 3yr committed base: 15% off -> $4,590 / GPU-eq / month
  * Annual prepay bonus: additional 5% -> $4,360 / GPU-eq / month (if prepay every year up front)
  * Volume band bonus: additional 5% if average committed >=150 GPU-eq across term
  * Max stacked discount available: 30% (effective floor $3,780 / GPU-eq / month)
- Example blended scenario (Stratus ask): 3yr term + Year1 split 50/50 + average commit 160 GPU-eq -> effective discount ~25% -> $4,050 / GPU-eq / month. We include an amortization schedule showing cash flow and the per-month effective unit price.
- Milestone credits: 5% of that tranche's annual value per missed tranche SLA, capped at 25% annual exposure.
- Quantization/instance mixing: supported. We will route quantized inference to compatible node pools; pricing unchanged but performance profiles will be documented in Appendix B.

Next steps: If this looks directionally correct, send us the preferred prepay option and we will prepare an MSA addendum plus a payment schedule for your finance team. For speed, we've also included a DocuSign link for the signature-ready term sheet section.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/rdw/RDW-2026-8743-term-sheet

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call to run the model with your FP&A.

— Karthik Iyer
Director, Pricing & Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
Attachment: RDW-Dedicated-Onramp-Proposal-v3.pdf (PDF, 320KB)
